_lisez_moi: Public values. Do not change them for your machine: write yours in reglages.json (same shape, only the keys to change), or through the environment variables (see outils/reglages.py). {donnees} = chemins.donnees; a relative path starts from the repository root.

atelier._lisez_moi: corps: the VRoid base (outils/base_vroid/fabriquer.py <model.vrm>). Without a VRM, the free MakeHuman base (outils/base_libre/fabriquer.py): body {donnees}/base-libre/corps.pmx, cache {donnees}/atelier-base-libre. One cache per body.

bibliotheque._lisez_moi: adresse: where outils/bibliotheque/bibliotheque.py installer fetches the ready-made library (a Hugging Face dataset, the folder that holds index.json); a local folder also works.

jeux._lisez_moi: actif: the game the models come from (its description: outils/jeux/<jeu>/jeu.json). Each description gives the public default of its source folders; jeux.<jeu>.<source> (e.g. jeux.zzz.mmd_extrait) changes them for your machine.
